boundaries: All results are freshly executed v8 checks, not recovered v7 count receipts.
Normal-input route drivers accelerate fixed engine time and use the actual application event/cutscene flow; neither route mutates health, position, score, or campaign flags.
Feature, collision, rendering and legacy-save scenarios are explicit fixtures separate from full routes.
Chromium141.0.7390.37, Firefox146.0.1, and WebKit26.0 were actually launched and ran the source game.
Chromium mobile-sized viewports include actual three-finger CDP touches. Physical Android, Termux, Logitech hardware, iPhone and Safari were not tested.

Chromium verifies actual decoded MP3 playback, crossfades,13 sampled cues, mute and pause. Firefox headless AudioContext remains suspended;13cue bytes cached and decode deferred. WebKit decodes cues, but the environment has no audible output device.

Launcher tests run actual local HTTP and exactpayload responses on port8788. Upgrade uses the recovered exact v7 launcher unchanged and confirms byte-for-byte backups and companion/browser-save fixtures.

The final archive-only display fix is verified by 16 targeted real-browser checks and 3 strict exact standalone embedding checks. Full behavior suites were not broadly repeated because no combat, campaign, scene, audio, save or source-frame data changed. Final launcher and v7-to-v8 upgrade tests were rerun against the final exact payload; repeats are counted once.

Broad behavioral suites used app.js ab13f22 and render.js e1c246 before the final archive-only orientation/bounds correction. Sixteen final source/offline archive checks, three strict embedding checks and seventeen final launcher/payload checks verify the affected boundary. Combat, campaign, scene, audio, save and source-frame data did not change in that final display fix.
No cold-network or physical Android loading-speed claim is made. Bulk startup intentionally prepares the full runtime library.
Portable evidence filenames refer to the offline release bundle; local workspace paths and private prompt/media files are excluded from this public report.

After the archive correction, native WebKit pause and concurrent-resume repairs changed only app audio lifecycle. Final focused 93 browser, clean WebKit 31, source Chromium audio 19, and refreshed embedding/launcher/upgrade 20 cases pass separately from the earlier 845-case scope.
knownLimitations: Physical Android, Termux on Android, Logitech hardware, iPhone and Safari were not tested.
Firefox headless AudioContext remained suspended; this run confirms cached cue bytes and deferred decode, not Firefox audible playback.
The environment has no audible output device; browser playback/decoding observations do not establish a listening test.
